judged_text: add_column :cook_method with default 1 silently reclassifies the interpretation of every existing post row under the new enum Post.cook_methods where :regular maps to 1, coupling the default's correctness to Discourse's Enum base offset with no test in the diff. If Post's Enum were ever changed to start at 0 (or a value inserted before :regular), every pre-existing post would be treated as raw_html and Post#cook would return raw unsanitized markup for all user posts; nothing in this migration or the model pins the mapping, so the schema and code are held together only by convention.
